shapeSummary: Simplified RS-555 planetary gear motor with its axis along Z at y=18.5, so the bottom sits at Y=0. It is a stack of cylinders: a 37mm gearbox housing (z -2 to 26), a 35mm motor can (z -38 to -2), a 37mm encoder cap (z -50 to -38), and an 8mm output shaft projecting 24mm (z 26 to 50).
warnings: Only the shaft diameter (8mm) and shaft length (24mm) are stated. The 37mm body diameter, 100mm overall length and the section lengths are estimates.
The REX shaft profile is modeled as a plain 8mm round cylinder.
Mounting holes on the gearbox face, the flat sides on the jacket, the encoder connector, wires, screws and the gearbox pilot boss are omitted because their dimensions are not legible.
The accessories shown in the image (U-channel, hub, gears, bearings, collar and so on) are not part of the motor and are not modeled.
cadquery:
def cyl(d, z0, z1):
    return cq.Workplane('XY', origin=(0, 18.5, z0)).circle(d / 2).extrude(z1 - z0)

gearbox = cyl(37, -2, 26)
motor = cyl(35, -38, -2)
encoder = cyl(37, -50, -38)
shaft = cyl(8, 26, 50)
part = gearbox.union(motor).union(encoder).union(shaft)
